description.en: The dblp Knowledge Graph (dblp KG) is a fully semantic view of all the data and relationships found in the dblp computer science bibliography. The dblp KG is synchronized daily with the current and curated data of the dblp bibliography.

full_download.title: dblp computer science bibliography – Monthly RDF/N-Triple Snapshot Release
full_download.description: This directory contains all the persistent dblp RDF/N-Triple data releases. The dblp computer science bibliography is the open indexing service and knowledge graph of the computer science community. dblp provides quality-checked and curated bibliographic metadata on major computer science journals, proceedings, and monographs, as well as metadata and identifiers about their authors and the venues they have been published in.

other_download.title: dblp KG Tutorial
other_download.description: With this tutorial we give dblp KG beginners a "guided tour" to help them find out what kind of data can be found in the knowledge graph. We encourage them to run examples, modify them to their liking on our live query server and try to develop own queries. We are convinced that the best way to learn how to query a new knowledge graph is to get right into it and play with it.

sparql.title: dblp SPARQL Query Service
sparql.description: The dblp SPARQL Query Service allows users to explore all the semantic content of the dblp computer science bibliography. This includes metadata about publications, their authors, the venues where they were published and metadata about these relationships. All data here is synchronized daily with the current and curated dblp data.
